classifications.rationale: The President presently makes the statutory finding that a specified 45-percent tariff rate is appropriate upon invocation of the reservation; the finding is part of the presidential act establishing the legally consequential tariff treatment, rather than a direction for an agency to decide the outcome later.
classifications.evidence: I find that upon invocation of the said reservation set forth in the second recital of this proclamation, effective October 1, 1956, it will be appropriate

classifications.rationale: As a continuation of the presidential finding, this segment presently establishes the initial quota threshold and finds that it satisfies the legally required production percentage; the tariff consequence applies upon entries exceeding that threshold.
classifications.evidence: which quantity I find to be not less than 1 1/4 per centum of the average annual production in the United States

classifications.rationale: The proclamation itself fixes the binding tariff rate at 45 percent and suspends prior proclamations as necessary to give that rate effect, producing immediate substantive legal consequences subject to the stated quantity triggers.
classifications.evidence: shall be 45 per centum ad valorem

classifications.rationale: The President directly amends an operative tariff-related list by deleting the specified line; the legal amendment occurs through this segment itself rather than through a later agency decision.
classifications.evidence: is hereby further amended by deleting the last line in item 1406 of such list
